title: UpdateProfile
description: The body of a request to change the caller's own display name, derived from identity_application::accounts::UpdateProfile. It carries no actor and no user_id: the caller is whoever the session says they are, and a field naming a target would be the confused-deputy shape this whole layer is written to make hard to write.
x-serde-status: the type is IMPLEMENTED as a shape; UpdateProfileCommand has no body and no route serves it

display_name.description: The new display name. A blank or oversized name is a domain refusal (ApplicationError::Domain), not an invented 400.

x-bounds.note: the Rust field is a plain String; the bound lives in the domain constructor, which is what UpdateProfileCommand's documentation points at

x-response: AccountView on success — the command returns the updated view rather than a status, so a client re-renders from the same document it already knows how to render.
x-phase: Phase 5 — Applications, grants, and the self-service surface
